extracted.name: Peanut Butter and Honey Sandwich
extracted.description: This recipe combines and spreads honey, peanut butter, and unsalted butter onto bread to make a simple, tasty, and delicious childhood sandwich favorite.
instruction_lines: Combine peanut butter, honey, and butter in a small bowl until smooth; spread on 1 bread slice. Top with remaining bread slice.
